title: Chapter 229 Good Vs Wang Shuo
content:
Chapter 229 Good Vs Wang Shuo

"There's someone on the other side who can answer." Gude rode out, walked forward for hundreds of meters, and entered the attack range of the crossbow battalion.

Wang Shuo, Ayub, and Gong Zheng also reined in their horses and moved forward, wanting to see what the other party wanted to say.

"Are you the ones who killed the third boss of my Pegasus Village?" Gude shouted loudly, with the momentum of a senior general, without disguising it.

Wang Shuo checked the other party's attributes.
